title: Whelp
wikitext:
[[Image:Blackwhelp.jpg|thumb|A Black Dragon Whelp in Redridge Mountains]]
A very young [[dragon]], often recently hatched.  In most cases, if someone finds a whelp, there will often be a larger [[drake]] or even a fully grown [[dragon]] nearby.

Whelps can be found in:
* [[Badlands]] (Black)
* [[Blackrock Spire]] (Black)
* [[Blackwing Lair]] (Black, Blue, Bronze, Green, Red)
* [[Burning Steppes]] (Black)
* [[Dustwallow Marsh]] (Black)
* [[Redridge Mountains]] (Black)
* [[Scholomance]] (Diseased)
* [[Swamp of Sorrows]] (Green)
* [[Wetlands]] (Red)
* [[Winterspring]] (Blue)
